subtitle: Out Manila · China Southern Airlines
overview: Fly with China Southern Airlines via Guangzhou to Changsha and travel to Zhangjiajie over the Spring Festival. Enjoy a skiing session at Qixing Mountain, the Avatar scenic area (Zhangjiajie National Forest Park) with a sparkler fireworks display, the Charming Xiangxi Show and free shopping in Changsha. Six nights in 5-star hotels; the rate includes several shopping stops.
travelDatesNote: Departures from Manila, Feb 3–9 2027 to Feb 4–10 2027. The rate changes by date: an amount on a date is added to the base rate per pax. Seats are limited and confirmed at booking.

itinerary.title: Manila – Guangzhou – Changsha
items: Fly Manila to Guangzhou (CZ398, 17:45–20:20), then connect to Changsha (CZ5592, 23:00–00:35+1)
Meet the tour guide and transfer to the hotel to check in

itinerary.title: Changsha – Zhangjiajie
items: After lunch, Qixing Mountain Scenic Area (battery car, 1520 Platform and glass skywalk included)
2-hour skiing experience (ski equipment included, snow suit not included)
If the ski resort is closed for weather, Qixing Mountain and skiing change to the indoor Snow and Ice World ski
After dinner, transfer back to the hotel

itinerary.title: Zhangjiajie
items: After dinner, transfer back to the hotel

itinerary.title: Zhangjiajie – Avatar scenic area
items: Compulsory shopping stop: Chinese medicine shop
Avatar scenic area (up and down by Bailong Lift or Tianzishan cable car)
Fireworks display, where you can take part with 4 handheld sparklers each
After dinner, transfer back to the hotel

itinerary.title: Zhangjiajie
items: Tea tasting at a tea shop, or a visit to a silk shop
Dinner upgrade: unlimited buffet-style hot pot

itinerary.title: Zhangjiajie – Changsha
items: Free shopping at Huangxing Road walkway street and Pozi Street
After dinner, transfer back to the hotel

itinerary.title: Changsha – Guangzhou – Manila
items: Transfer to Changsha airport and fly to Guangzhou (CZ3387, 08:00–09:40), then connect to Manila (CZ397, 14:15–16:50)

placeDesc.Qixing Mountain: A scenic mountain area near Zhangjiajie with a glass skywalk and a ski experience on this tour.
placeDesc.1520 Platform: A viewing platform at Qixing Mountain, included with the battery car ride.
placeDesc.72-Floor Stilts Tower: A tall building in Zhangjiajie raised on stilts, seen from outside.
placeDesc.Junsheng Sandstone Painting Museum: A museum of pictures made from Zhangjiajie's coloured sandstone.
placeDesc.Avatar scenic area (Zhangjiajie National: Quartz-sandstone pillar peaks that inspired the Avatar film, reached by Bailong Lift or Tianzishan cable car.
placeDesc.Bailong Lift: A large outdoor glass elevator that takes visitors up the cliff in the scenic area.
placeDesc.Tianzishan: A mountain in the Zhangjiajie park area, reached by cable car.
placeDesc.No.1 Bridge: A natural stone bridge spanning a gap in the Zhangjiajie sandstone peaks.
placeDesc.Avatar Hallelujah Mountain: A floating-mountain landmark in the park that inspired the film's Hallelujah Mountains.
placeDesc.West Sea Stone Forest: A viewpoint area of stone pillars in the scenic park.
placeDesc.Charming Xiangxi Show: A large stage show about the culture and legends of western Hunan, performed in Zhangjiajie.
placeDesc.Huangxing Road: A busy pedestrian shopping street in central Changsha.
placeDesc.Pozi Street: An old street in Changsha known for its local snacks and shops.
